notes.title: LAST STANCE
notes.content:
Hello JuVenturers,

while we are working very hard on finishing JuVentures, we started a new game (after all, when the art is done, it's on the developer to finish a game, while the [url=https://www.illustrationleipzig.de/linktree]artist (aka JujiBla)[/url] can already work on other projects).

[h2]LAST STANCE[/h2]

We are proud to present you our next game: [b]Last Stance[/b], which you can [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2237460/Last_Stance_A_JuVentures_Game/]wish list now on steam[/url]. 
Last Stance will be another full-release without early access.
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2237460/Last_Stance_A_JuVentures_Game/]

notes.title: 🐍 LABOR OF LOVE 💖
notes.content:
Hello Juventurers, 

the all famous Steam Awards are upon us again and we humbly ask you to consider the JuVentures to be your Labor of Love nomine  (or any other category you might find fitting).

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/steamawards/nominations?snr=]NOMINATE HERE (in case you viewing this post on a page without the award nomination link/banner)[/url]

We know we have a fairly little chance to win, but you never know till you try and so we continue our JuVenture and bring you highly irregular fancy, amazing and exciting updates. The story mode looms already on the horizon.

"Wait, I have read that before haven't I?" you might ask and yes you did.
This is a nearly copy+paste of the previous years invitation to nominate us.
"But why (so lazy)?", you might ask rightfully. The answer is:
What should we change?
It's the same award every year and we are working on our passion project every year since 2017, there is just nothing else to add.
So if you like our fun little passion project, maybe give it a nomination (and/or a (hopefully) positive review).

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31524592/963f249f74a35152f72f64f805cd05e8c30916cb.jpg[/img]

Thank you for your ongoing support, playing our game 💖 and stay safe!

- JujiBla & the SpielmannSpiel team.

notes.title: JuVentures Coloring Book Supporter DLC
notes.content:
Hello juventurers,

it's been a wild ride so far.

Back in 2018 we made a coloring book competition and got some fantastic art back.
Some of you (probably the same people) also wanted to support us even more and since art-books are a thing on steam to support games and their creators even more, so we combined that in this supporter DLC 💖.

[h2]YOU GET[/h2]

You get 27+ awesome drawings from JujiBla to color in as a High-Quality PDF.
That's it 💖

[spoiler]We are also working on an Amazon print on demand version, so you don't have to print it yourself in the future.[/spoiler]

notes.title: 📓 Nita's Diary Update ✒️
notes.content:
Hello Juventurers,

this is a really BIG update, are you ready? I hope WE are ːsteamhappyː

We have an all new scene for you to seek out: Nita's Room 🚪
Not only has it a lot to find, there is also a nice souvenir shelf where Nita puts all the amazing things she finds, so you might want to come back here from time to time.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31524592/458d8bd6982308b8dc24f0fdd72b9ff62644b74e.png[/img]

Ah the Diary, a feature planned for so long that the ticket number has 2 digits (#82), we are currently on ticket [strike]#181[/strike] #184.
All the weird, magical and wondrous things Nita finds are written down here with detailed descriptions, drawings and schematics. You can look up a lot of things that are hard to find when you just do not know what they actually are, like Actias Luna, Kakapo and the Beear.
It is [b]FAR FROM COMPLETION[/b] but it has a lot of the essential entries and will be updated over time.

[b]Update Features:[/b]
[list]
[*] Nita's Diary 📓
[*] New Scene: Nita's Room 🚪
[*] World Map 🗺️
[*] Interactive Tutorial ℹ️🐍
[*] Bug Fixes 🐛
[*] Improvements 🛠️
[/list]

Enjoy one of our biggest and most important updates :ghsmile:

- JujiBla

notes.title: SUBquarium 🐟
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31524592/e6dc6d5f7f51d90ec3036e492cd7ae22af68061d.png[/img]
Hello Juventurers,

this time you get a fresh-splash for the heat, the SUBquarium, where my Twitch subscribers swim around on stream, is now in-game.

Every subscriber [url=https://www.twitch.tv/jujibla]on my Twitch channel[/url] gets a sub-animation of their design* that swims in the on-screen SUBquarium when the person is in chat. After that every 3 month the subscribers get an additional frame (max 3) and with their 2nd frame they will be placed ingame (and there they will stay even after they stop subscribing).
So basically all subs can now go on a self-discovery journey 💖.

This update includes:

[list]
[*] new scene: SUBquarium 🐟
[*] new launcher 🚀
[*] intro 🎬💖
[*] engine update 🚂
[*] overall polishing 💅
[*] Twitch subscribers in credits 🧑‍🤝‍🧑
[*] and more 🕹️
[/list]

Have fun everyone 💖

- JujiBla


* The usual statement for drawings:
While you can choose what your sub-drawing is supposed to be, I  will only draw sub-animations that are SFW and Twitch conform. I won't draw violence or anything hateful.
Sub-drawings will also be drawn in a simpler cartoonish style, so everything big and complex will be simplified.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31524592/7bddcc46deebc76ce9c5569443dcb5d1ac2c5d99.png[/img]

Hello juventurers,

we are proud to reveal the newest scene Rock Shelter to you, the players.
As the project moves on, we’ve finally started polishing. There are a lot of performance tweaks (especially to reduce the long loading times) and long wished features as well. One of the biggest issues you had became the newest feature:
the Sound Settings will now be saved.
YES, that’s right, this amazing, revolutionary feature is now available for all of you!
And as always, we hope you enjoy this new release ːghsmileː

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31524592/dea3dac61aeb9622ee80935a38571ac37007062a.jpg[/img]

Oh, by the way: you can now play the very first available version of JuVentures from steam, on steam.
The “historical” branch has been released to the public.
Just go to the GAME SETTINGS (right click), select the BETA tab and switch to the “historical” branch.
WARNING: playing this old version  will definitely reset your savegame and remove your progress and settings.

And here is a quite incomplete changelog, with the (hopefully) interesting parts for you.

We’ve omitted boring technical stuff, so while there is even more going on, this way we get to focus on the interesting information that you, the players, will likely notice within the game.
Also there are currently two new scenes in the making. We hope you’re excited, we certainly are  ːghsmileː.

notes.title: Update v0.4.9 - BUGTALES
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31524592/e6cdd622e7c71530dbedcabbf6acd25d764a3d50.png[/img]

Space: the final frontier. These are the voyages of a hidden objects game...

No, that’s not a feature, it was a game-breaking bug and I am really really sorry for that.
I usually test 2-3 scenes after every release, so I got the wrong ones this time. Some scenes had this bug that made it impossible to play, finish or even leave the game. Thanks to [url=https://www.twitch.tv/theferalelite]FeRaL[/url]  who streamed and recorded it, so I was able to fix it “quickly” (this bug was there for around 3 days).

I apologize to all players and hope you can still enjoy our little game. 

- bison

notes.title: Update v0.4.1 - Patch Runner
notes.content:
Hello juventurers,

These past few days have been really busy, fixing all the hidden bugs you have found and enjoying you enjoying our game. Thank you very much 💖
Since we patched instantly and didn’t want to spam you with tiny change logs, this is a collection of everything we put into JuVentures since the launch at 5.1.2018.
There is still a lot to do, and we will keep updating instantly to bring you the best game experience as soon as possible, so there will be from time to time a patch-rundown like this one when we finish a milestone.
Just that you don’t wonder if nothing is going on. Players will see the current version number in game.

[url=http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31524592/6d878f8b2ed67f831ac36388aa6d871712733e52.png][img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31524592/f7bdb9c7928a132b63aeaadef7945aef46d80b36.png[/img][/url]

All changes from youngest to oldest:

[list]
[*]v0.4.1 - steam update
[*]clicking on the pictures starts the level
[*]fix: prevent coffee from drifting into space
[*]settings from within the game
[*]v0.4.0
[*]fix: UI arrows
[*]fix: compass start flicker
[*]optimizing compass zoom on dune
[*]top-menu: graphics: arrows
[*]v0.3.13 - steam update
[*]lock max compass scale to 1
[*]prepare volume save
[*]top-menu: graphics: scrollbar
[*]fix: tutorial save bug

[*]scale compass on zoom
[*]save tutorial state
[*]tutorial UI optimized
[*]v0.3.11 - hotfix
[*]added: objects to find counter
[*]removed: escape to exit
[*]fix: natural arch: compass glitch
[*]v0.3.10 - steam release
[/list]

- JujiBla
